notes: Legal-form clue said United Kingdom, but the matching entity is Indian: Shilton Hospitality LLP, LLPIN AAB-8264, registered on Ulsoor Road, Bangalore, incorporated 18 October 2013, active (paperli.ai). Medium because the press release (20th anniversary, December 2025) describes the group and does not name the LLP. Source page headline is mismatched (prosthetics); its body is the Shilton release. UK Shilton Hotel Ltd (12748464) and Chilton Hospitality Limited are different companies.

what_it_does: Scottsdale, Arizona developer-tools firm, formerly Axosoft, that sells the GitKraken Git desktop client for Mac, Windows and Linux plus GitLens for VS Code and Git Integration for Jira to software developers and teams.
